positions.title: Senior System Analyst
positions.description:
+ Worked as System Product Specialist to develop NEC Automated Fingerprint Matching System. The product was deployed in several countries including Vietnam, Singapore, India, Philippines, US, Japan

+ Designed and developed Fingerprint client program which is a .NET Winform Application that integrated with Webservice and Oracle Database Server 11g. The program was deployed for various central government offices in Singapore and Vietnam. 

+ Setup, troubleshot and configured products on HP/NEC/IBM Blade Server under Redhat Linux OS
